# Test fixtures

`mosparo-frontend.js` is the unmodified frontend script of
[mosparo](https://github.com/mosparo/mosparo) v1.5.15
(`assets/mosparo-frontend.js`), copied here so the tests can run the real
widget without a mosparo instance. It is MIT licensed; see `mosparo-LICENSE`.

To update it, replace the file with the one from a newer mosparo release and
change the version above.
